title: Don't Ask How It Can Be
body:
(Mawlana Shaykh stands.)
Allahu akbar, Allahu akbar, la ilaaha illa-Llah, Allahu akbar, Allahu akbar, wa lillahi 'l-hamd!
This is our very humble glorifying for our Creator, the Lord of Heavens, Lord of Divinely Presence. If we may
be standing up to the last day of our lives or up to end of dunya or from today up to eternal, it is nothing. We
can't give any glorifying for the Lord of Heavens, but we are weak servants and we can only do this and He
Almighty Allah is accepting. And we are giving glorifying and honors that He is giving to his Divinely
Presence's servant Prophet Muhammad (s), alfu salaat, alfu salaam `ala sayyidi 'l-awaleena w 'al-akhireen.
Raghman - in spite of those people who don't like to give to you glorifying and honor. We are against them;
we are trying to give more glorifying to O our most beloved Prophet Rasulullah, Sayyidina Muhammad (s).
There is a whole heavenly level where angels are giving their salutes to that most honored one in the Divine
Presence, Sayyidina Muhammad (s). When he was passing that Night Journey, from that time up to eternal,
angels giving to him much more salutes, saying alfu salaat, alfu salaam `ala sayyidi 'l-awaleena w 'al-akhireen.
(Mawlana Shaykh sits.)
I am asking forgiveness from my Lord. the Lord of Heavens, not to be weaker up to the end of my life, to be

able to grant my most high respects to His most honored one in His Divinely Presence. And I am asking
support from my master, my trainer. My trainer is teaching me, the master of this world, that is the line of
adab - good manners. And I am saying, "O my master, support me!" Because I am knowing nothing. What it
is necessary for me, servants... O Mankind, What it is necessary for him to say, he knows saraa'ir - the secrets
of Mankind. He is the pole that is like the polestar, never changing. He also is never changing his positions.
And for every time they are changing, but on same root. They are keeping the whole world and looking after
everything. They have gigantic powers for looking out for this world and everything on it. They have gigantic
powers, extraordinary capacity and ability for idaret etmek, managing everything on earth.
Someone may say, "How can it be?" It can be only by the command of the Lord of Heavens. He is dressing; if
He is dressing even one atom, that atom may do. Authorized one. From whom authorized? From that one
whom he is the most honored and glorified in Divinely Presence. Authority must be among nature, on this
planet that we are on it now, but the dominions of the Lord of Heavens are countless. Dominions are always
going to be according to the main center that is granted to Creation. Dominion. And through His dominions,
countless creatures, never-ending.
Don't ask how it can be. Don't ask. As holy command, don't ask: ••• ••••••••••• •••• •••••••• ••• •••••• ••••••
•••••••••• - "laa tus'alu `an ashyaain in tubda lakum tasuuwakum - Ask not questions about things which, if
made plain to you, may cause you trouble. (5:101)
That is an endless ocean, and no depth, no beach. Because it may be that you can't carry something that you
are asking; it may give you some trouble through your minds and your minds can't carry. Then you should be
harmed. Therefore, don't ask questions about something if it is not necessary. Don't ask. It may be terrible for
you.
Therefore, when we are saying something, don't ask how it can be. You must believe that He is Almighty, alQaadir, al-Muqtadir. Qaadir is ability Almighty, endless. Endless. He can do everything. It may be that thing
is impossible for you, but it is not impossible. Possibility is just a grant to Mankind on this planet. And
countless worlds, countless creations, all of them are granted some possibility (they) may reach. But
impossible things our minds can't carry, and they may give us harm, harming people.
Because the Lord of Heavens, you can't give a balance for Him and for His Divinely Attributes. They say for

something that may be, something a person can say and ask the Lord of Heavens, He can put this world
through an atom's space. That is impossible for creatures, but for the Creator it is not something that is
making Him unable. No. We are living in a world in which everything may be possible. But don't say, "Behind
these possibilities, what is there?" Don't ask. No . That is giving you harm, harming you. Yes, one person may
command this world from east to west, from north to south. Allah Almighty is dressing that one with such a
power that you can't imagine. Such a small authority, to make this world under the command of one man.
Yes. I am always surprised when I am looking at a gigantic aircraft carrier. You may look and you are saying it
is like an island under the command of a person. He is making his fingers like this (Mawlana gestures) and
this huge aircraft carrier is making a landing. If we are thinking on it, we are saying, "Impossible!" if a person
is never seeing such a big ship, a warship. And he may say, "Do you know that gigantic aircraft carrier, I am
moving it myself?" He is saying "No, it can't be!" You are saying that he is only like you, a man. And like you,
a man, one million can't reach the bigness of this carrier. Look how it is making its way to the right or to the
left, under the command of that small creature. And they are saying, "He is captain of this ship, it is under his
command."
If it is possible for a man to do that, what about the Creator? If He is dressing one person, he can be like an
atom. And that smallest part of material is going to be like a man. And if I am saying this one is controlling
this huge planet, you may say, "It can't be." Why can't it be? It must be! (Mawlana smiles)
Therefore, religious beliefs are giving Man always new horizons. They are giving to every smallest part of
time, and they may give to that one such a knowledge and possibility for controlling this huge world. An atom
can be able to control this huge world! Don't say it can't be; it can be possible. Possible! Impossible, no! In
Divinely Presence, everything is possible. And beyond that possibility, we are knowing there are so many
dominions of possibility. (Mawlana Shaykh raises his hands, breathes out) oh, oh, oh, Huuuuu.
(Mawlana Shaykh stands)
Therefore we are saying Allahu akbar, Allahu akbar, Allahu akbar, la ilaha illa Anta, Allahu akbar!!
(Mawlana Shaykh sits)
O People! Now we are reaching to the end of our period on this planet. Therefore, some new understandings

from heavenly ones are beginning to come on Earth like waves of power. And making even one weakest
creature to give a warning. O People, we are reaching now, soon we are reaching to an end on this planet! Be
prepared! Try to make your understanding wider, because in front of you there should be some happenings
you are going to see, to hear, and to understand or not to understand. You must prepare yourselves, and it is
not possible to know such a things from universities or high schools or academies.
No. Heavenly powers now preparing things. Urging people to stand up and look. Enough to be drunk with
your material being. Prepare your heavenly beings. Stand up and look to see realities. Wake up! Such waves
are now beginning to come. People may believe that a small instrument is speaking to them, some voices are
coming and saying, "We are addressing to you, O Muslims from Western countries." They are saying, "Yes, it
is possible." But they are not giving such a care that it is coming through the atmosphere. Such an instrument
is giving a proof that this atmosphere is not empty. It is full with powers and countless lights ... of power
reaching, coming up to this planet.
Widen your understanding that you may reach countless horizons of knowledge, heavenly knowledge
through your spirituality. Your material being is going to be dust but we are taking from that secret, that
through this secret earth going to be ... to do so many things, going to be something. But when you take that
secret power, you are falling down, going to be earth. Therefore, there is no value, going to graveyard,
finished. Waves are coming through our atmosphere, but beyond our atmosphere there are countless
atmospheres. Don't think that this planet it is on emptiness. No. Emptiness, no. You cant find an empty point
through space. It is not empty, but filled with strange waves, that one is never going to be the same as the
second one.
This is all to prepare Mankind for the Day of Resurrection, or the Day of Judgment. How it should be dealt
that day? It is going to open. Therefore, the Lord of Heavens is saying... Iqra kitabaka kafa binafsika alyawma
AAalayka haseeban, (It will be said to him): ••••••• ••••••••• ••••• •••••••••• ••••••••• •••••••• •••••••• (17:14 "Iqraa kitaabaka kafaa bi-nafsika'l-yawma `alayka haseeba - Read your book. You yourself are sufficient as a
reckoner against you this Day." Al-Isra (17:14)
"Say what you are understanding through your whole life." What are you understanding? "O my Lord, I only
tried to make my physical being to be happy. I was running for that only. I lived for my physical being. I left it

and I am coming to You." You are understanding nothing, you are ignorant. Time is over now. That is a
preparation to all nations, to all religions, to whole Mankind. Listen and try to understand. And we are on the
lowest level now, that is making me to speak. Don't think that it is too much, no. It is the lowest level of
strange knowledge for the Creator's actions.
Actions, actions. O, this is an action from the Lord of Heavens, this world, and one day it is going to
disappear and going through endless power oceans. As it was through endless Power Oceans from the Lord of
Heavens, and He ordered '"Come and be ready for some creation of Mine to be on you and make them to live
and to try to learn something for themselves." And the Reality that it should be opened for them, is going to
be an entrance to reach another level of knowledge for understanding their Lord.
It is such a deep ocean. And as time is over now, (they are) making to make such a speech through one weak
servant. Holy Qur'an is just giving every knowledge; everything that happened or should happen or should be
happening.
•••••• ••••• ••••••• ••••• •••••• ••••••••• ••••••• •••••••• ••• •••••••• ••••••••• ••••••••• ••••••••••••• ••• •••••••••••••••
••••••••••• ••••••••••• •••••• ••• •••••••••••
hatta idha aataw `ala waadee 'n-namla qaalat namlatun yaa ayyuha 'n-namlu 'dkhuloo masaakinakum laa
yahtimannakum sulaymaanu wa junooduhu wa hum la yash`uroona, "Till, when they reached the Valley of
the Ants, an ant exclaimed: O ants! Enter your dwellings lest Solomon and his armies crush you,
unperceiving." An-Naml (27:18)
The Lord of Heavens is saying that an ant is warning its tribe. Saying, "O ants take your care!" Take your
caution because coming is the army of King Solomon, not to put his army's horses, their feet on you. Give
way! And it is such a position now. The Holy Qur'an is giving an opening to some realities. That Holy Qur'an
is an endless ocean. Endless oceans. Not one ocean, but endless oceans. Now is the time that a warning is
coming from heavens. It was an ant speaking to its tribe. And this one that I am sitting here, the Lord of
Heavens, not directly but through the pole of this world, is giving warning to people. O People! Hear that
there is coming such strange and horrible, horrible actions. Beware! Keep yourselves! Keep yourselves away,
not to make on you something that is coming to make you finished. Coming now fearful and horrible actions,
wars coming....

And this is a warning to say, "Take care, take your protection, try to protect yourself." And you are looking
and seeing that from east to west, from north to south, people are fighting among themselves. And this is a
beginning, but very heavy actions, events, happenings are coming behind this. This is only like a windy air,
but whole hurricanes are coming behind that. Take your care. Therefore, that instrument is making people to
hear and to listen to some new understandings from the Holy Qur'an that Allah granted us. If not (listening),
then they should be taken away. Hurricanes should take away. May Allah forgive us.
(Mawlana Shaykh sings)
Dome dome dome dome 8x
If you can hear beautiful singing,
your souls are directly running,
leaving your physical being
and running for that heavenly singing.
Dome dome dome dome 8x
You are our Lord! No doubt all praisings and whole honor and whole glory for You, the Lord of Heavens.
(Arabic)? We are understanding on that level, but beyond that we are not granted yet. When we are reaching
that last point of this level, another whole level is coming . Countless levels. O glorifying! O people come and
listen! Enough running after that carcass. Carcass, carcass. We are only living to eat and drink and finally to
see ... That is not honor for real being. O mankind take a little bit of care. O Pope, give morning and evening a
declaration! O chief Rabbi, say about this issue morning and evening! O Muslims, once again you look at
Holy Qur'an morning and evening, to appear to you such a powerful meaning and full of hope oceans and
dominions!
(Mawlana Shaykh stands)
O our Lord! Allahu akbar, wa lillahi 'l-hamd! As-salaatu w 'as-salaam `ala Sayyidina Muhammad (s)! Assalaamu `alaykum O our listeners! Where are you? You are happy? You must be happy!
(Mawlana Shaykh sits)
Fatihah. (48 minutes) (Mawlana smiles)
